svg.desc: Wide Frutiger Aero vector wallpaper for software, warm golden peach and mint palette. Rolling emerald hills under a luminous apricot sky, calm water in the foreground, a few translucent bubbles and delicate curved light trails along the edges. Clear smooth shapes and soft gradients, optimistic nature-meets-technology aesthetic of the 2000s. Spacious low-contrast center for software content. Full bleed, no text, no logo, no border, no interface or panels.
